prompt:
Create a NEW NATIVE 16-frame sprite sheet for the same named character, correcting the reference as explicitly specified. Use the supplied accepted source32 design as the identity/equipment reference: retain its olive tactical cap/goggles and olive/tan original Soldier armour. NO CrimsonRaiders flag, NO summoned turret, no magic aura and no Borderlands2 costume. Keep both hands on the same physical assault rifle.
EXACT ROW ORDER: Row1 four distinct entering walking poses, rifle lowered; row2 four distinct progressively braced and shouldered aiming stances; row3 four different aimed firing/recoil stances, entire barrel inside each cell, no detached muzzle flashes or brass crossing adjacent figures; row4 four distinct lowering/withdrawal poses.
